purpose: Public sparse-convolution comparator source inspection; no device execution or weights download.
findings: K6 fuses row-major gather, tilize, FP32-weight tap matmuls and SFPU bias/residual/ReLU; multicast weights along grid rows, exact FP32 partial reload, two data-movement cores gather alternate present taps.
Blackhole p150 native path uses HiFi4, FP32 weights and row-major BF16 tables; complete sparse encoder supports multi-layer fused MKS levels.

Native full-model trace timings and PCC gates are not comparable to the Wormhole HiFi3 tiled-BF16 contract. Need architecture port, input/output conversions, disabled ReLU and residuals, every output row written, matched goldens and complete-operator scope.

K6 plans by taps, but a single 1024x4096 tap needs 16 MiB FP32 weights per core; current planner cannot fit our largest widths without additional channel partitioning. Narrow 64/128-channel layers are the reasonable port starting point.
Local hf CLI returned exit 1 due click.exceptions.Exit: 0 after completing downloads. Files inspected directly; pinned TT environment was not upgraded.
